verdict.rationale: Cua describes itself as open source infrastructure (Spaces, Driver, Lume, SDK, Bench). The SDK runs computers locally on Docker/Podman, QEMU or Lume with any OCI image, and `cua runtime setup` installs what a host needs. Any machine you own can run cua-spacesd and be reached directly by address and token, and community users report running Lume and Cua locally on their own Macs. Missing for 10: evidence that the Spaces relay/coordination layer can be self-hosted rather than only connecting your own machines to Cua's service, and a dedicated self-hosting guide covering the full stack.
